##### Project general facts

Takaya is a premium residential project by Union Properties. This unique community offers a blend of contemporary living spaces, featuring three modern residential towers with stunning views, alongside townhouses and villas nestled around the base for privacy within a vibrant community. With its modern design and strategic location, Takaya promises an elevated lifestyle experience in one of Dubai's most sought-after areas.

Residents enjoy a rich array of amenities designed for the ultimate living experience, including an infinity pool, a fully equipped gym, a spacious lounge area, and a children's playroom. The community is dotted with verdant parks and features everything needed for a measured and fulfilling family life, including shopping centers, park areas, sports facilities, and playgrounds. The unique podium connects the high-rise towers with the townhouses, creating a seamless community experience.

Every residence at Takaya is meticulously crafted to ensure a high standard of living. Interiors are designed in calm pastel colors using high-end materials, creating spaces of refined comfort and sophistication. Studios, one to four-bedroom apartments, and four to five-bedroom townhouses and villas offer a variety of layouts to suit different preferences. Kitchens are fully equipped with Siemens appliances, and the apartments are fully finished using high-quality modern materials.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the heart of Motor City, this exceptional location offers a unique and lively community that combines the essence of urban living with a captivating theme centered around the world of motorsports and automobiles. The area is an embodiment of modernity, innovation, and passion for all things automotive, with streets adorned with a distinct charm echoing the excitement of racing.

The location is distinguished by its exceptional connectivity and recreational offerings. Situated between major highways, the community provides easy access to Dubai's iconic locations, with the famous Dubai Autodrome just a short walk away. Miracle Garden, Burj Al Arab, Palm Jumeirah, and Dubai International Airport are all within easy reach, making it an ideal base for both residents and visitors.

For those seeking a residence that embodies urban energy, automotive passion, and family-friendly living, Motor City delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of green spaces, recreational facilities, and a prime location makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living — vibrant, connected and effortlessly inspiring.
